description: Make Trellis update honor selected workflow provenance
changelog:
**Workflow update fix:**
- Generic `trellis update` now resolves the project's selected workflow from immutable provenance instead of comparing a Marketplace workflow with bundled native bytes.
- Legacy untracked custom workflows remain outside the generic update set.
- Provenance identity checks are shared by update and verify, with a regression test preventing false native `.new` candidates.
notes: Run npm install -g @pennixrv/trellis@beta then trellis update. No --migrate required.
